svg.title: A team on one CorvinOS instance
svg.desc: People in shared chat channels reach one operator-run CorvinOS instance; per-chat roles, consent, quota and proposals admit each message before the gates and the worker run; everything lands in one tenant audit chain. The web console is single-operator.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: People work in the chat channels they already use. The operator runs the instance; the console is theirs alone.
